# Generated by tools/build_sect_content.py.
ac_sect_random_identity_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:ember_peak } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:mirror_tide } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:thunder_hoof } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:jade_mountain } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:veiled_moon } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:dawn_lotus } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:ashen_blade } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:sky_palm } }
	}
}

ac_sect_teach_identity_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:ember_peak }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_tiger }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_akakiru }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_fire }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:mirror_tide }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_crane }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_aoyusumu }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_water }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:thunder_hoof }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_stallion }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_kiihakai }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_storm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:jade_mountain }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_ox }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_midorikatai }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_earth }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:veiled_moon }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_snake }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_kurokonton }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_darkness }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:dawn_lotus }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_dragon }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_aoyusumu }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_light }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:ashen_blade }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_wolf }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_akakiru }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_fire }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:sky_palm }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_monkey }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_midorikatai }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_wind }
	}
}

ac_sect_teach_second_element_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:ember_peak ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_earth } } add_trait = ac_element_earth }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_fire }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:mirror_tide ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_ice } } add_trait = ac_element_ice }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_water }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:thunder_hoof ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_wind } } add_trait = ac_element_wind }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_storm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:jade_mountain ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_light } } add_trait = ac_element_light }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_earth }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:veiled_moon ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_ice } } add_trait = ac_element_ice }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_darkness }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:dawn_lotus ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_water } } add_trait = ac_element_water }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_light }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:ashen_blade ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_darkness } } add_trait = ac_element_darkness }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_fire }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:sky_palm ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_storm } } add_trait = ac_element_storm }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_wind }
	}
}

# A small opening remains in both ranks for players and subsequent recruitment.
ac_sect_seed_roster_effect = {
	var:ac_sect = { save_scope_as = ac_seeded_sect }
	while = {
		count = ac_sect_initial_upper
		ac_sect_seed_disciple_effect = { RANK = upper }
	}
	while = {
		count = ac_sect_initial_lower
		ac_sect_seed_disciple_effect = { RANK = lower }
	}
	var:ac_sect = { ac_sect_recount_effect = yes }
}
ac_sect_seed_disciple_effect = {
	create_character = {
		gender_female_chance = 50
		age = { 20 38 }
		culture = this.culture
		faith = this.faith
		location = scope:ac_seeded_sect.var:ac_headquarters
		random_traits = yes
		save_scope_as = ac_seeded_member
	}
	scope:ac_seeded_member = {
		set_variable = { name = ac_sect value = scope:ac_seeded_sect }
		set_variable = { name = ac_sect_contribution value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = ac_sect_merit value = 0 }
		add_trait = ac_cultivator
		add_trait = ac_sect_$RANK$_disciple
		ac_sect_teach_identity_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = ac_sect_upper_disciple }
			set_variable = { name = ac_sect_merit value = 150 }
			ac_sect_teach_second_element_effect = yes
			add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_cultivator track = ac_core_power value = 15 }
		}
	}
	scope:ac_seeded_sect = { add_to_variable_list = { name = ac_members target = scope:ac_seeded_member } }
}
